title: The Ring in the Teacup
youtube_title: The Ring in the Teacup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Ximena finds a pale ring left by tea on a saucer, like a tiny planet. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Ximena shows Violeta how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
